title: D\'ej\`a View: A Shared Working-Memory Model for Visual Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.23177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A working-memory model must remember stimuli and use its memory flexibly to perform different tasks. Here we introduce a model of working memory for images that combines dynamic activity with temporary associations between image features. We train the model on five tasks, including remembering a sample while other images are presented, categorizing distractor images while remembering the sample, and determining whether an image is new or has been presented before. The same trained model performs all tasks, guided by explicit cues about which response is required. We use this flexible memory model to ask how delay, distraction, and image history affect performance. Delays have little effect on sample-memory performance for the delays we tested, while seeing more images leads to more false alarms even when the target image appeared equally recently in all cases. translated_title: 似曾相见：面向视觉任务的共享工作记忆模型
translated_abstract: 工作记忆模型必须能够记住刺激，并灵活运用其记忆来执行不同的任务。本文提出了一个针对图像的工作记忆模型，该模型将动态活动与图像特征之间的临时关联相结合。我们在五个任务上训练该模型，包括在其他图像呈现期间记住样本图像、在记住样本的同时对干扰图像进行分类，以及判断一幅图像是新出现的还是之前呈现过的。同一个训练好的模型可以执行所有任务，并通过明确的提示信号来指导所需做出的响应。我们利用这一灵活的记忆模型研究了延迟、干扰和图像历史对性能的影响。在我们测试的延迟范围内，延迟对样本记忆性能几乎没有影响；而即使目标图像在所有条件下出现的近期程度相同，看到更多的图像仍会导致更多的虚报。在样本记忆加分类任务中，正确拒……
tldr: 该研究提出了一个将动态活动与图像特征间临时关联相结合的共享工作记忆模型，单个训练后的模型即可在提示引导下灵活完成图像记忆、干扰分类和新旧识别等多种视觉任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a shared working-memory model for images that combines dynamic activity with temporary associations between image features, enabling a single trained model to flexibly perform multiple visual tasks—including sample memory, distractor categorization, and novelty detection—guided by explicit task cues.
